description:
Presidential Secretariat - appointed Mr. Somarathna Vidanapathirana as the Secretary to the Ministry of Tourism and Lands,
with effect from August 24, 2024.
categorisation: This gazette content specifically announces the appointment of a named individual (Mr. Somarathna Vidanapathirana) to a government position (Secretary to the Ministry of Tourism and Lands) with an effective date. It contains a personnel change with a basic title but does not include any detailed description of the portfolio responsibilities or duties associated with the position. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
